title: A Journey Dispatch to the whole cohort is posted to enrollees' feeds

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-10-26 (audits/meta-scan-2026-10-26.md), Phase 4 follow-up: Dispatch to a cohort

detail: Journey Dispatch (SCAN-1150) pushed to the cohort but posted nothing to the Dispatch feed, because dispatches rows could only be scoped to a Circle, Hub, Nexus, Space or everyone. Migration 20270346025200_dispatch_journey_scope.sql adds a journey tier (audience_id is the journey plan id; additive, idempotent, the same shape as the Space tier in 20270106000000). A send to the whole cohort (everyone, or both halves) now also publishes one journey-scoped dispatches row; a half-cohort send is pushed but not posted, because a feed row reaches every enrollee. Reach: viewerInDispatchAudience gains a journey case over journeyPlanIds (required on DispatchViewerContext, fail-closed), read from journey_enrollments in the feed viewer context, the right-rail reader and the digest. The migration must be applied before the post works; until then the insert is rejected by the check, the push still goes, and the result reports the push only.

verify.note: Exits 0 once the cohort Dispatch posts a journey-scoped row, the migration widens the scope, and the audience gate has a journey case.
